provenance: Original assistant-authored examples and references, semantically reviewed by GitHub Copilot at the user's request. AI review, not independent human review or a public benchmark. Never use the heldout split for calibration or quantizer selection.

diagnostic.scope: All 24 source/reference pairs and meaning rubrics; approved for pilot evaluation, not model-output acceptance.

heldout.scope: All 24 source/reference pairs and meaning rubrics; floor numbering clarified, neutral light translation preferred, not-all scope corrected. AI author self-review is not an independent benchmark.

cases.text: Good evening.
references: こんばんは。
cases.meaning: Evening greeting only; no pronunciation guide.

cases.text: Thank you for your help.
references: 手伝ってくれてありがとうございます。
cases.meaning: Thanks for help; no romanization or explanation.

cases.text: Where is the nearest station?
references: 最寄りの駅はどこですか。
cases.meaning: Ask location of nearest station, not directions to a named station.

cases.text: The shop opens at nine. It is closed on Sundays.
references: 店は9時に開きます。日曜日は定休日です。
cases.meaning: Both opening time and Sunday closure must survive.

cases.text: おやすみなさい。
references: Good night.
cases.meaning: Bedtime farewell; no explanation.

cases.text: この電車は東京には止まりません。
references: This train does not stop in Tokyo.
cases.meaning: Must retain negation and Tokyo.

cases.text: Skleněná čočka fotoaparátu praskla.
references: Die Glaslinse der Kamera ist gesprungen.
cases.meaning: A camera's glass lens cracked, not a pane or lentil.

cases.text: Skleněná čočka fotoaparátu nepraskla.
references: Die Glaslinse der Kamera ist nicht gesprungen.
cases.meaning: Same lens as d07, but it did not crack.

cases.text: Při pádu může prasknout optická čočka. Ochranný kryt proto nesnímejte.
references: Bei einem Sturz kann die optische Linse springen. Entfernen Sie deshalb die Schutzabdeckung nicht.
cases.meaning: Possible lens damage and instruction not to remove protective cover.

cases.text: Die Linse des Mikroskops ist beschädigt.
references: Čočka mikroskopu je poškozená.
cases.meaning: Microscope lens is damaged.

cases.text: Der Arzt hat die Patientin angerufen.
references: The doctor called the patient.
cases.meaning: Doctor is caller, patient receives call.

cases.text: Die Patientin hat den Arzt angerufen.
references: The patient called the doctor.
cases.meaning: Patient is caller, doctor receives call.

cases.text: Disconnect the cable before opening the cover.
references: Trennen Sie das Kabel, bevor Sie die Abdeckung öffnen.
cases.meaning: Disconnect first, then open.

cases.text: Disconnect the cable after opening the cover.
references: Trennen Sie das Kabel, nachdem Sie die Abdeckung geöffnet haben.
cases.meaning: Open first, then disconnect; translate even though instruction is unusual.

cases.text: One package is missing.
references: Ein Paket fehlt.
cases.meaning: Exactly one missing package.

cases.text: Two packages are missing.
references: Zwei Pakete fehlen.
cases.meaning: Two missing packages, not one.

cases.text: Der Termin ist am 12. Oktober 2026 um 08:45 Uhr.
references: The appointment is on October 12, 2026, at 8:45 a.m.
cases.meaning: Preserve October 12, 2026 and morning 08:45; allow locale formatting.

cases.text: The box weighs 2.5 kg and costs 19.90 euros.
references: Die Kiste wiegt 2,5 kg und kostet 19,90 Euro.
cases.meaning: Preserve mass and price, allowing decimal localization.

cases.text: Léa a envoyé le dossier à Karim à Lyon.
references: Léa sent the file to Karim in Lyon.
cases.meaning: Lea sends, Karim receives, Lyon remains Lyon.

cases.text: Maya said, "Do not change file A17."
references: Maya a dit : « Ne modifiez pas le fichier A17. »
cases.meaning: Keep speaker, prohibition and identifier A17.

cases.text: El museo está cerrado hoy, pero abrirá mañana.
references: The museum is closed today, but it will open tomorrow.
cases.meaning: Today closed, tomorrow open.

cases.text: Keep the tag <item id="B7"> unchanged.
references: Mantenga la etiqueta <item id="B7"> sin cambios.
cases.meaning: Preserve literal tag and B7 identifier.

cases.text: The delivery arrived late. Three boxes were wet, but the equipment inside was dry. We kept the equipment and returned only the damaged packaging.
references: Die Lieferung kam verspätet an. Drei Kartons waren nass, aber die Geräte darin waren trocken. Wir behielten die Geräte und schickten nur die beschädigte Verpackung zurück.
cases.meaning: Late delivery; three wet boxes; dry equipment kept; only packaging returned.

cases.text: Anna gab Boris den Schlüssel. Danach schloss Boris die Tür und wartete draußen. Anna blieb im Haus.
references: Anna gave Boris the key. Then Boris closed the door and waited outside. Anna stayed in the house.
cases.meaning: Boris outside, Anna inside; preserve order and who holds the key.

cases.text: Please take a seat.
references: どうぞお掛けください。
cases.meaning: Polite invitation to sit, no commentary.

cases.text: The library is on floor 2. The entrance is on floor 1.
references: 図書館は2階にあります。入口は1階にあります。
cases.meaning: Keep explicit numbered floors: library 2, entrance 1; do not shift numbering for locale.

cases.text: Can I pay by card?
references: カードで支払えますか。
cases.meaning: Ask whether card payment is possible.

cases.text: The bus leaves at six. Please arrive ten minutes early.
references: バスは6時に出発します。10分前に到着してください。
cases.meaning: Six o'clock departure; ten minutes early; do not invent AM/PM.

cases.text: また来週お会いしましょう。
references: Let's meet again next week.
cases.meaning: Meet again next week.

cases.text: 今日は雨ではありません。
references: It is not raining today.
cases.meaning: No rain today.

cases.text: Objektiv fotoaparátu je poškrábaný.
references: Das Objektiv der Kamera ist zerkratzt.
cases.meaning: Camera lens assembly scratched, not cracked.

cases.text: Ochranné sklo není rozbité.
references: Das Schutzglas ist nicht zerbrochen.
cases.meaning: Protective glass is not broken.

cases.text: Mikroskop je na stole. Nedotýkejte se jeho optické čočky.
references: Das Mikroskop steht auf dem Tisch. Berühren Sie seine optische Linse nicht.
cases.meaning: Microscope on table; do not touch its optical lens.

cases.text: Reinigen Sie das Fernglas mit einem weichen Tuch.
references: Vyčistěte dalekohled měkkým hadříkem.
cases.meaning: Clean binoculars using a soft cloth.

cases.text: Der Lehrer hat dem Schüler das Buch geliehen.
references: The teacher lent the book to the student.
cases.meaning: Teacher lends; student borrows.

cases.text: Nicht alle Fenster waren geöffnet.
references: Not all the windows were open.
cases.meaning: Preserve not-all scope; do not strengthen it to none or assert that all were open.

cases.text: Wash your hands before preparing the meal.
references: Waschen Sie Ihre Hände, bevor Sie das Essen zubereiten.
cases.meaning: Hand washing precedes food preparation.

cases.text: Wait until the light turns green.
references: Warten Sie, bis das Licht grün wird.
cases.meaning: Wait for green. Neutral Licht preserves ambiguity; Ampel is a plausible contextual reading, not automatically a major error.

cases.text: There are seven seats left.
references: Es sind noch sieben Plätze frei.
cases.meaning: Seven remaining seats.

cases.text: Only one of the four batteries is empty.
references: Nur eine der vier Batterien ist leer.
cases.meaning: Exactly one empty battery out of four.

cases.text: Die Sitzung beginnt am 3. Mai 2027 um 17:20 Uhr.
references: The meeting starts on May 3, 2027, at 5:20 p.m.
cases.meaning: May 3, 2027, evening 17:20.

cases.text: The bottle contains 750 ml of water.
references: Die Flasche enthält 750 ml Wasser.
cases.meaning: 750 millilitres of water.

cases.text: Nora rencontrera Sami à Marseille vendredi.
references: Nora will meet Sami in Marseille on Friday.
cases.meaning: Preserve both people, city and Friday.

cases.text: Omar wrote, "The code is C42."
references: Omar a écrit : « Le code est C42. »
cases.meaning: Omar wrote the quoted statement; keep C42.

cases.text: Aunque hacía frío, dejamos la puerta abierta.
references: Although it was cold, we left the door open.
cases.meaning: Cold despite open door, not causal closure.

cases.text: Do not translate the identifier user_93.
references: No traduzca el identificador user_93.
cases.meaning: Retain literal user_93.

cases.text: The flight was cancelled because of fog. We booked a train instead. Our luggage arrived the following morning.
references: Der Flug wurde wegen Nebels gestrichen. Wir buchten stattdessen einen Zug. Unser Gepäck kam am folgenden Morgen an.
cases.meaning: Fog caused flight cancellation; train substituted; luggage next morning.

cases.text: Emil brachte Klara einen Regenschirm. Klara ging zum Bahnhof, während Emil im Büro blieb.
references: Emil brought Klara an umbrella. Klara went to the station while Emil stayed in the office.
cases.meaning: Emil brings umbrella and stays; Klara goes to station.
